newsitem.title: USA: NuCo2 to buy back up to 250,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: NuCo2 to buy back up to 250,000 shares.

text.p: NuCo2 Inc said Friday its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to 250,000 shares of its outstanding common stock.
Purchases will be made from time to time in the open market at prevailing market prices and may also be made in privately negotiated transactions, said the company.
NuCo2 Inc currently has 7,163,434 shares of common stock outstanding.
The company supplies bulk carbon dioxide systems and liquid carbon dioxide to retail establishments for use in the carbonation and dispensing of fountain beverages.
